warnings: Structural sheet index. maps_to_png applies the house-wide +2 offset (printed page + 2) confirmed on this very sheet: its footer reads 32 and it is PNG 34.
Footing marks named in the index are F1, F3, F6, F8, F10, F12 and F18 -- a much wider range than house 06's F1-F4, and each pair gets its own enlargement sheet (S-07..S-10).
Beam marks are B1-B7 plus RB1, GB1 and GB1X (S-12); slab marks S0 and S1-S3 (S-13); stairs ST-1 and ST-2 (S-14).

S-15's title 'แสดงการยึดเสา ค.ส.ล. กับคานเหล็กและจันทัน' shows this is a HYBRID structure: reinforced-concrete columns carrying STEEL roof beams and rafters. Expect both main_bar/stirrup and steel_section (spec §6a) in this house.

S-16 and S-17 have IDENTICAL printed titles ('ขยายรายละเอียดรอยต่อพื้นสำเร็จรูป SP'). Transcribed as printed; the two sheets presumably cover different joint conditions but the index does not distinguish them.
